from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, sys
root = Path('.').resolve()
native = root / 'native'
main = root / 'native/inir-mpdd/src/main.rs'
def check(pkg=None):
    argv = ['cargo','fmt']
    if pkg: argv += ['--package', pkg]
    else: argv += ['--all']
    argv += ['--','--check']
    return subprocess.run(argv, cwd=native, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).returncode
mpd = check('inir-mpdd')
niri = check('inir-native')
allrc = check(None)
if allrc == 0:
    raise SystemExit(0)
if mpd != 0 and niri != 0:
    raise SystemExit(44)
if mpd == 0 and niri != 0:
    raise SystemExit(51)
if mpd == 0 and niri == 0:
    raise SystemExit(52)
before = main.read_text()
r = subprocess.run(['cargo','fmt','--package','inir-mpdd'], cwd=native, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
if r.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(53)
after = main.read_text()
names = subprocess.run(['git','diff','--name-only'], cwd=root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.splitlines()
needle = '                borrowed.expect("serialize borrowed daemon result")\n            );'
pred1 = before.replace(needle, '                borrowed.expect("serialize borrowed daemon result"),\n            );', 1)
pred2 = pred1.replace('\n    }\n\n}', '\n    }\n}', 1)
if names == ['native/inir-mpdd/src/main.rs'] and after == pred1:
    raise SystemExit(41)
if names == ['native/inir-mpdd/src/main.rs'] and after == pred2:
    raise SystemExit(42)
